$comment: The nine stat blocks under 'Encounters' on page a2 of The 5 Treasures, in the same shape as the rulebook's 50 opponents so the engine's attackStrength takes either. LOOT is carried in notes until Phase 5's adventure format gives it a field. page is the adventure folio, not a rulebook page.
title: The 5 Treasures: foes
label: rule

records.name: Devil servant
records.description: Sneaky minion, easily frightened if alone (use the Oracle for the number of devils)
records.notes: LOOT: 1-3 junk; 4-5 simple weapon; 6 a Hint (inferred, I-08).

records.name: Dexterous Ghost
records.description: A spirit servant, quick yet clumsy.
records.notes: LOOT: private quarter's key. Met in the Attendants room.

records.name: Junior King Silver Horn
records.description: Cunny demon, master swordsman. He takes orders only from his elder brother.
records.notes: LOOT: seven-star sword. One entity across tables (inferred, I-33c).

records.name: Monk
records.description: Unlucky traveller with a vegetarian diet.
records.notes: LOOT: 1-2 rosary; 3-4 baoding balls; 5-6 elixir. A rescue, not an enemy (inferred, I-39).

records.name: Ogre
records.description: Half human brute with long fangs.

records.name: Old Vixen
records.description: Animal spirit in the appearance of an old lady.

records.name: Senior King Golden Horn
records.description: Lord of the cave; sturdy demon with helmet, breast plate and a cloak of red silk.

records.name: Skillful Beast
records.description: A monsterlike devil with fighting quality, but not a sharp mind

records.name: Woodgatherer
records.description: They know the mountain, but living in a dangerous place made them irritable.
records.notes: LOOT: Great Bear scripture [recited keeps beasts away]. A band, ATT 5 (inferred, I-05b).
